hero.title: Discover Senegal through its flavours, its traditions and its Teranga.
hero.subtitle: Authentic cooking and cultural workshops in small groups — to cook, understand and share.

intro.title: An open house, a shared table
intro.text1: Kër Téranga opens the doors of Senegalese culture through its most generous expression: its food. Here you don't watch, you take part: you discover the ingredients, cook, taste and listen to the stories behind every gesture.
intro.text2: Each workshop is a moment of transmission, guided by the founder, an ambassador of Senegalese gastronomy, so you leave with new skills, memories and a little piece of Senegal in your heart.

featured.title: Thiéboudiène Workshop
featured.text: Cook Senegal's national dish together — listed as UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage — from the market to the shared bowl.

about.title: A home, a culture, a way of welcoming
about.intro: Kër Téranga was born from a simple belief: the best way to understand a country is to sit at its table.

name.title: The meaning of our name
name.kerText: "home" in Wolof — the place where you welcome, gather and pass things on.
name.terangaText: Senegalese hospitality, a founding value made of generosity, sharing and respect for others.
name.together: Kër Téranga means "the house of hospitality": a place where every visitor is welcomed like family.

history.text: [To be completed: the story of Kër Téranga, told by the founder.]

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: To bring Senegalese culture to life through authentic, accessible and warm food experiences that celebrate local produce and the people who grow, sell and cook it.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.text: To become a reference for cultural and culinary tourism in Senegal, and a living embassy of Teranga for travellers from all over the world.

heritage.title: Our commitment to heritage
heritage.text: Our workshops are designed to pass culture on faithfully, without folklore or caricature:
points: Recipes and techniques that respect tradition
A cultural presentation projected on screen
Discovering the local ingredients of thiéboudiène
Celebrating a dish listed as UNESCO heritage in 2021
